page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 72 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 288.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this server type. The lack of integrated local storage and GPU accelerators represents a tradeoff, positioning this instance primarily for workloads that rely on external storage systems and standard CPU processing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g5ne.18xlarge offers a high-density resource profile suitable for enterprise-scale deployments that require significant CPU and memory capacity without the premium cost of specialized GPU or local storage hardware. Appropriate workloads for this configuration include general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and medium-sized databases that utilize network-attached storage.
